summary: Post-market, 2026-10-09. The composite settled at 50.75 in the caution band, effectively flat on the day with a trend_1d of -0.01, inside an unchanged goldilocks regime at a 0.9068 model confidence. The session was a rotation rather than a reversal: capital left AI hardware for AI software, with cybersecurity 3.4652, cloud computing 2.7801, enterprise software 2.6006, AI software 2.5966, gaming 2.4276 and networking 2.394 against quantum computing -2.1623, semiconductors -0.6924, the semis basket -0.5584, memory -0.4482 and AI infrastructure 0.0663. Large-cap hardware split: AVGO 0.6775 and TSLA 2.3013 recovered while AMD -1.7682, MU -0.8742 and NVDA -0.269 did not. Credit widened, with HY OAS moving from 3.09 to 3.15; VIX rose from 15.08 to 15.41; the 10Y yield held at 5.28 and the real 10Y at 2.92 stayed at the 99.84 percentile. Breadth remains the weak spot: 0.5742 of 155 names above their 200-day average, with small caps -8.884 and semis -2.9368 relative. The snapshots were taken 23 minutes before the cash close, so they are not closing prices, and the dollar leg has not refreshed from its 2026-10-02 vintage.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation remains the largest single contribution at 7.50, reading 0.5 with 4 of the 8 production signals triggered, and it is a proxy discounted to 0.8.
The macro block is the binding constraint at 71.16: the 10Y real rate at 2.92 sits at the 99.84 percentile, the 10Y yield at 5.28 scores 99.68, the curve spread is 0.51 and the 2Y is 4.77.
The high-yield credit spread widened to 3.15, contributing 5.10, and is now the second-largest driver inside a liquidity and credit block that rose to 61.43.
Reverse repo contributed 3.84 while its level sits at 0.3, the 2.00 percentile, which the neutral direction maps to a 95.99 risk score.
Breadth stayed the weakest structural leg: 0.5742 of 155 names above their 200-day average, small caps at -8.884 relative and semis at -2.9368 relative.

supporting_signals.claim: Software and platform verticals carried the session: cybersecurity 3.4652, cloud computing 2.7801, enterprise software 2.6006 and AI software 2.5966.
Volatility stayed contained: VIX at 15.41 is only the 26.98 percentile and realized volatility at 10.0191 keeps the volatility block at 19.09.
Tesla led the rebound, up 2.3013 to 383.630005, with the auto basket matching it at 2.3014.
The mainland China storage and semiconductor complex closed split rather than uniformly lower, with 688825.sh up 0.9501 and 688008.sh up 0.2995.

4 of the 8 production cross-asset signals triggered, at dollar strength 121.3848, real-rate pressure 2.92, small-cap underperformance -8.884 and gold up 1.5251, while the SPY, copper, bitcoin and high-yield signals did not.

contradicting_signals.claim: The rebound did not move the composite: total_score stayed at 50.75 with trend_1d at -0.01, because credit widened to 3.15 and VIX rose to 15.41.
The largest single driver, cross-asset confirmation at 7.50, partly rests on a dollar index frozen at 121.3848 from the 2026-10-02 vintage, and it is a proxy at a 0.8 discount.
Breadth did not confirm the rally: the new-high ratio is 0.109 against a new-low ratio of 0.0962 across 156 names, with semis at -2.9368 relative.
AI infrastructure barely participated at 0.0663 while quantum computing fell 2.1623, so the hardware complex is not confirming the software bid.
The rate and dollar inputs still lag: the 10Y and the 2Y carry a 2026-10-07 vintage and the dollar a 2026-10-02 vintage, so the caution reading is partly backward-looking.

what_changed_today: The AI complex rotated from hardware into software: cloud computing 2.7801, cybersecurity 3.4652 and AI software 2.5966 against semiconductors -0.6924 and quantum computing -2.1623.
The composite was flat: 50.75 with trend_1d at -0.01 and trend_1w at -1.42.
Credit widened: HY OAS 3.15 against 3.09 previously, while IG OAS held at 0.82.
Volatility ticked up: VIX 15.41 against 15.08 previously.
Rates held at the long end and eased at the front: the 10Y at 5.28 against 5.27, the 2Y at 4.77 against 4.79 and the real 10Y at 2.92 against 2.91.
Large-cap hardware split: AVGO 0.6775 and TSLA 2.3013 turned positive while NVDA -0.269, MU -0.8742 and AMD -1.7682 stayed negative.
Reverse repo printed 0.3 against 0.335 on a same-day 2026-10-09 vintage, and the Fed balance sheet rose to 6747560 from 6743031.
The mainland China close stayed under pressure but split: 8 of the 11 storage and semiconductor names we track were lower, led by 300475.sz at -6.8216, while 688825.sh gained 0.9501.
The dollar index still carries the 2026-10-02 vintage at 121.3848 and feeds the largest driver, cross-asset confirmation.
watch_next: US CPI on 2026-10-14 is the next high-importance macro print and the cleanest test of whether the hike priced at 4.07 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88 survives.
PPI and advance retail sales follow on 2026-10-15.
The US bank earnings cluster on 2026-10-13, spanning JPM, C, GS, JNJ, UNH and WFC, opens third-quarter reporting, with BAC on 2026-10-14.
Whether the software-led rebound broadens into hardware, where semiconductors sit at -0.6924 and memory at -0.4482.
Whether HY OAS keeps widening past 3.15 and whether the real 10Y at 2.92 pushes further beyond the 99.84 percentile.
Whether breadth repairs, with the new-high ratio at 0.109 and the new-low ratio at 0.0962.
TSM reports on 2026-10-15 and TSLA on 2026-10-21.
Whether the dollar leg refreshes from its 2026-10-02 vintage, which would mechanically change the largest driver.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the software bid broadens
points: Cybersecurity at 3.4652 and cloud computing at 2.7801 keep leading and pull AI infrastructure up from 0.0663.
VIX at 15.41 holds the lower part of its range and the volatility block at 19.09 keeps the composite contained.
Breadth at 0.5742 above the 200-day average holds and the composite drifts below 50.75.

base_case.title: Base case: rotation without resolution
points: The composite oscillates near 50.75 while the macro block at 71.16 remains the binding constraint.
Credit and volatility offset the equity rebound, with HY OAS at 3.15 and VIX at 15.41.
Semis at -2.9368 relative and small caps at -8.884 relative keep the equity structure block at 48.50.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the long end and credit turn together
points: HY OAS breaks above 3.15 while the real 10Y at 2.92 and the 10Y at 5.28 extend their percentile extremes.
Semis at -2.9368 relative extend and drag breadth below 0.5742.
Quantum computing at -2.1623 spreads across the AI complex and the composite breaks above 60.
